title: Watch what happens after it reads your files
caption:
Microsoft's Windows Copilot now reads local files and data and takes action on them automatically.

Satya Nadella announced the feature, called Hybrid Intelligence, in a post on X.
With permission, it accesses local files and business data and processes them using on-device AI models.
In the demo, it reads the data and sends a formatted email to the user's accountant.
